$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema, or the page stops showing after a build. options follow defaultRunOptions in store.json.

tasks.name: foundit-jobs-last-24-hours
tasks.title: Find the newest foundit jobs posted in the last 24 hours
tasks.description: Get the 100 newest jobs that foundit first listed in the last day, across all nine sites from India to the Gulf and Southeast Asia, with the company, location, experience asked and link. A renewed old job does not count as new. Set Number of jobs to 0 to get every one, and schedule it daily.
tasks.seoTitle: New foundit Jobs in the Last 24 Hours
tasks.seoDescription: The newest jobs first listed on foundit and Monster India in the last day, with company, location, experience and link. Run it daily for a fresh feed.
